order: Exercise all five evidence-band seats and record the results fully. Run Scout and Investigator in-harness, and run Researcher, LC Analyst, and the documents lane of Archivist through the external runner used for that lane. If a run's own verification shows a problem with the run itself, such as a command runner that was down, that run must be discarded rather than accepted at face value, and re-run instead under a stricter integrity check before its result counts. Record every incident and follow-on that turns up across the exercises, including any transient tooling fault, rather than smoothing them over or leaving them out. Update the exercise log with the results table, the incidents, the follow-ons and each seat's order text worded as issued. Update the plan's status page too, so it reflects the stage this band has now reached.
claims: All five seats were exercised, and the results were recorded fully. Scout and Investigator ran in-harness and both passed, across 9 files touched altogether, with nothing outside that set moved. The first run of the Researcher seat fabricated citations while its own verification admitted the command runner was down, so that run was discarded outright. The retry under a stricter check correctly returned a blocked result instead of a false pass, and two runs hit the same transient tooling fault, noted as a follow-on.
